name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: A fellow Forsaken asks you to thank Danitha Morr for the paladins’ service at Bandarion Keep. Your work has earned the Deathguard’s gratitude and brings a gift of redemption.

sections.title: Thanks at the Keep
sections.body: A fellow Forsaken asks you to carry their thanks to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep. The rest of the Deathguard will hear of the service you and the other paladins performed. They are proud to count you among the Forsaken and trust the Dark Lady watches over you.

sections.title: A Gift of Light
sections.body: Danitha says a paladin ready to receive one of the Light’s greatest blessings can use the Symbol of Life. She bestows redemption upon you, letting you resurrect fallen companions. Your service matters to the Forsaken and the paladins of Bandarion Keep. The Deathguard hopes such acts will win the hearts and minds of fellow Forsaken.

faq.answer: You are asked to thank Danitha Morr for the paladins’ service at Bandarion Keep.

faq.q: Who will hear about the service?
faq.answer: The rest of the Deathguard will hear of the paladins’ service at Bandarion Keep.

faq.q: What does the Symbol of Life do?
faq.answer: The Symbol of Life can be used by a paladin ready to receive one of the Light’s greatest blessings.

faq.q: Why is the Deathguard proud of me?
faq.answer: The Deathguard is proud to count you among the Forsaken and values the service you performed with the paladins of Bandarion Keep.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
